items.title: Results posted for a study about Obesity-Related Malignant Neoplasm
items.summary: Fred Hutchinson Cancer Center ran this final-stage test (phase 3) with 418 people. The registry lists its end date as 7 Sep 2026. The study team posted its results on ClinicalTrials.gov. Our search of PubMed for this study’s number (NCT04447313) found no journal article. Searches can miss articles, so one may already exist. We don’t say here whether the treatment worked. The official study record has the full results.
